comparison.objective: Set snowboard bindings to a specified stance width and angle, with versions ranging from placement to screw fastening; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part bimanual placement, planar pose alignment and, in fastening versions, screw insertion/regrasping versus small hex-key access, collar tuning and response-based iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Binding flatness, ±15° angles, 40 cm spacing and version-specific screw seating versus two safe carriage stops and lock retention. Candidate numeric dynamic limits remain incomplete.
comparison.reason: Static geometric setup and fastening do not test adjustment of a dissipative mechanism from observed impacts.
